inputs.subject: Help with redecorating my 10-year-old daughter's unicorn-themed room — colors & $1,200 budget
inputs.body:
Hi Alara,

I hope you’re well. I’d love your help redecorating my 10-year-old daughter’s room with a unicorn theme. We’ve decided on the following specific color choices and a firm budget, and I want to ask if you can take this on and advise on next steps.

Design details:
- Daughter: 10 years old, loves unicorns
- Walls: soft pastel lavender (#E6E6FA)
- Curtains: blush pink (#F4C2C2)
- Bed (frame/headboard): crisp white (#FFFFFF) with gold accent hardware
- Pillows: a mix of pastel pink, mint green, and lavender with one metallic gold sequin unicorn accent pillow (mainly pastel pink, mint, lavender + gold accent)

Budget: $1,200 USD (total budget for paint, curtains, bedding, pillows, small decor, and any installation/labor you recommend)

What I need from you:
- Your assessment of whether $1,200 is realistic for these choices (paint, curtains, bed updates/accents, pillows, a few unicorn-themed accessories, and light labor)
- A rough cost breakdown and any ways to prioritize spending if needed
- Recommendations for specific products, suppliers, or pieces (curtain style/length, paint finish, pillow types, and where to find a gold sequin unicorn accent pillow)
- Any installation or labor you would recommend and an estimate of those costs
- Your availability to consult (in-person or virtual) and an estimated timeline for completing the project

If you’re able to help, could you send a brief plan and an estimate? I’m happy to meet or chat at your convenience.

Thanks so much — looking forward to working with you.

Best,
[Your Name]
